agreement_routed.what_crosses: the Step-0 voice gap between T_0 and the draft S (sh.voice_rms, recorded as vg_g): up to the cut that keeps 95% of clean prompts -> the whole estimate at Step 4; up to the largest clean gap -> Voice-Swap at Step 4; beyond it -> the student alone
agreement_routed.cuts: out of fold over 5 folds of the pilot's speakers (random.Random(2026) shuffle), from the other folds' clean-prompt gaps
agreement_routed.scoring: the stored outputs of the same cases and seeds (W4 EXP-018, STT_4 EXP-020, student4 EXP-017) against the stored reference; pitch variety: each clean diversity prompt follows its clean case's route, W4 from this pilot's CVf0, STT_4 and student4 from EXP-020's stored CVf0
agreement_routed.offline_screen: round 5, with EXP-020's Step-4 gap as a stand-in: 7.60 mean passes out of fold, every rule passed, clean CVf0 -0.0052 (docs/progress/log/2026-11-13-offline-solution-screen.md)
agreement_routed.literature: targeted searches 2026-11-13 found no method that routes inputs by teacher-student disagreement on the voice or compares a teacher's first-step estimate with a student's output to decide what crosses

two_axis.what_crosses: prompt SNR >= snr_threshold: the whole estimate; within band_db below it: Voice-Swap at Step 4 (EXP-020's STT); below that: nothing, the student alone
two_axis.when: on the whole-estimate branch: Step 3 if A_3 = d_1 + d_2 + d_3 >= lambda3 (d_k = the sampler's compute_stabilization_drift, as stored in EXP-018), else Step 4
two_axis.fit: on the stored EXP-018 data of the 60 Quick-set speakers (all 360 cases): snr_threshold keeps 95% of clean prompts on the whole branch; lambda3 is the most permissive action threshold whose routing keeps mean capped-WER difference <= +0.01 (clean) and <= +0.025 (degraded), similarity >= -0.01 and UTMOS >= -0.05 against the whole estimate at Step 8
two_axis.offline_screen: out of fold over 5 speaker folds: 6.73 mean passes, every measured rule passed, pitch variety at Step 3 unmeasured (docs/progress/log/2026-11-13-offline-solution-screen.md)
two_axis.literature: targeted searches 2026-11-13 found no published policy choosing both when and what crosses; each part is known

purpose: Development pilot of Decision Handover before any frozen test: is the guided teacher's first estimate shared across seeds, and does handing the student only the teacher's seed-specific change keep quality and pitch variety at Steps 2-3; for the Two-Axis Handover, does its choice of a Step-3 handover keep pitch variety; and for the Agreement-Routed Handover, does routing by the Step-0 teacher-student voice gap keep quality, cost and pitch variety

algorithm.decision: D_k = slow(T_k) - slow(T_0) on generated frames, with T_k the teacher's endpoint estimate at Step k and slow() EXP-020's 9-frame split (sh.decompose)
algorithm.handover: x_k(g) = voice(S) + fine(S) + slow(T_k) + g (slow(S) - slow(T_0)); g = 1 is S + D_k; g = 0 is EXP-022's STS; prompt frames from T_k
algorithm.draft: S = eps + g(eps, 0), one student pass from independent noise (seed + 1009), as in EXP-020
algorithm.student: the released student loop at j = 1 from x_k
algorithm.unguided: the teacher's conditional branch only, 1 pass per step, same grid and Euler update as sampler.run_teacher_single_pass

completion.source: rho_k = (CVf0 STS_k - CVf0 student4) / (CVf0 plain_8 - CVf0 student4), clean prompts, EXP-022 and EXP-020 diversity files, matched speakers

data.quality: the first 20 EXP-012 Quick-set development speakers x ['clean', 'gauss20', 'noisy15'] (60 cases), synthesis seed = input seed
data.seeds: the first 10 speakers x ['clean', 'noisy15'] x 4 seeds (input_seed + 2000 + m), teacher only, Steps 0-4, prompt degradation fixed
data.diversity: the first 10 speakers x ['clean'] x 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m), all six outputs plus the whole-estimate handovers W3 and W4 and the Two-Axis Handover's per-seed choice between them
data.reused: plain Step 8 (EXP-018), student only (EXP-017), Voice-Swap STT_4 (EXP-020), STS_2 and STS_3 (EXP-022) on the same cases and seeds; stored CVf0 of plain_8, STS_2, STS_3 (EXP-022) and student4 (EXP-020)

hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only; Shonget-DMOSpeech2 at the pinned commit
smoke: must reproduce the stored STS_3 scores (EXP-022, tolerance 0.01) and match the released guided teacher with teacher_loop(guided=True) (max abs difference <= 0.0001) before the full run

criteria.G1_first_estimate_shared: guided teacher, slow part: median over pairs of (spread across seeds at Step 0) / (spread at Step 3) <= 0.25 on clean and on noisy15
criteria.G2_variant: for each output: passes <= 12; pooled capped-WER minus the reference, upper bound <= +0.025; similarity minus the reference, lower bound >= -0.01; mean WER minus STS at the same step on degraded prompts <= 0; clean CVf0 minus the stored reference, mean >= -0.01
criteria.G3_two_axis_pitch_variety: on the 10 clean diversity prompts: CVf0 of the Two-Axis Handover (its per-seed choice between W3 and W4 on the whole branch; the stored Voice-Swap or student-alone CVf0 on the other branches) minus the stored reference, mean >= -0.01
criteria.G4_agreement_routed: out of fold on the 60 quality cases with 5 speaker folds: misroutes by the Step-0 voice gap (a clean case sent to the student alone, or a degraded case sent to the whole estimate) at most 1 more than by the prompt-SNR rule (95% clean coverage, 2.0 dB Voice-Swap band) on the same cases and folds; mean passes <= 14.7; clean CVf0 minus the stored reference, mean >= -0.01; absolute quality against the stored reference is reported, not judged

decision_rule: advance Decision Handover to a frozen test on new speakers only if G1 holds and at least one output meets G2; the output carried forward is the cheapest that meets G2 (ties: lower pooled WER); separately, advance the Two-Axis Handover only if G3 holds, and the Agreement-Routed Handover only if G4 holds; otherwise report a negative pilot for that candidate, with no retuning on these data
descriptive: spreads and shared shares for every part and step, both trajectories
decision signals per condition (size, turning, size relative to the draft, Step-0 voice gap)
every output against the reference, STS at the same step, Voice-Swap and the student alone
the Two-Axis Handover's W3 and W4 pitch variety alone, its share of Step-3 handovers, W4 against EXP-020's stored plain_4, and its in-sample replay on the 360 stored cases
the Agreement-Routed Handover's routes per condition and its cuts per fold
evidence_status: development pilot on speakers that designed EXP-020 and EXP-022; not evidence for a claim
novelty: to our knowledge no published handover passes only the teacher's seed-specific change onto the student's own sample (targeted searches 2026-11-13; closest: DiFA, single-model deviation guidance; Gandikota and Bau, whole-state switch after the base model's first step; Distillation++, teacher refines student estimates); not a full literature review
adoption: not adopted; changing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
